story.headline: The federal government and Jamaat-i-Islami agreed on Thursday, at a meeting between Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif and JI chief Hafiz Naeemur Rehman at the PM House in Islamabad, to form a committee to further deliberate on and implement JI's recommendations for the economy, Dawn reports.
